demo.title: clash-onchain-buy-chest.sh
demo.code:
# Buy a Silver chest (type 0, 1,000,000 $CLASH)
bankr prompt "using the clash-onchain-buy-chest skill, buy a silver chest"

# Buy a Gold chest (type 1, 3,000,000 $CLASH) - 60 Common + 8 Rare + 2 Epic
bankr prompt "using the clash-onchain-buy-chest skill, buy a gold chest"

# Buy a Magical chest (type 2, 5,000,000 $CLASH) - 120 Common + 25 Rare + 5 Epic
bankr prompt "using the clash-onchain-buy-chest skill, buy a magical chest"

# Every card comes out at L1 - upgrades are a separate flow
bankr prompt "using the clash-onchain-buy-chest skill, show my card inventory"

setup: Install the Bankr CLI: `npm install -g @bankr/cli` and run `bankr login` - the skill signs the chest purchase with the Bankr agent wallet
Hold $CLASH on Base Mainnet: Silver 1M, Gold 3M, Magical 5M $CLASH per chest
The purchase goes through the Clash Onchain ChestManager contract on Base Mainnet
